messages:
Kara: Heads-up — saw a weird bump in p95 for /v1/embed after the routing-tag normalization deploy last night. p50 looks unchanged. screenshot: https://img.internal/xyz (small)
Matt: I noticed that too. p95 +28ms cluster-wide across EU region. No corresponding error spike.
Samira: Could be provenance merge weirdness. When we normalized tags we ended up merging previously distinct sample groups. If t-digests were merged without adjusting weights that can nudge high quantiles.
Devon: I ran a quick diff on raw samples:
```
# query run against raw_ingest (not rollups)
SELECT count(*) AS cnt, approx_percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95, source_tag
FROM raw_latency
WHERE route = '/v1/embed' AND ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY source_tag;
```
Results: gateway: cnt=120k p95=210ms, router: cnt=8k p95=420ms, post-normalize merged into 'router' => effective p95 ~410ms.
Jen: So normalization collapsed a low-volume high-latency source into the big group. t-digest weighted merge will shift P95 up. Not a bug in runtime, more an aggregation/attribution surprise.
Alec: ops-bot reported the tag normalization roll forward at 2026-03-20T22:12 UTC. @Matt can we pin which rollout cohort saw the biggest change?
Matt: Looking now — traffic from a partner client (client-x) used older gateway path with occasional 2x latency. Their samples were small but extreme. After normalization their samples got rolled into the main route aggregates.
Kara: UX impact: console p95 jumped and triggered a stale SLO alert for the owning team. They paged SRE. We should avoid this surprise.
Samira: Short-term: add a provenance badge to the percentile sparkline showing sample_count and top contributing source_tag. Quick mock: show "p95 (count=128k, top=router:62%)" next to value.
Devon: Longer-term: change rollup merging to keep provenance buckets for tail percentiles OR compute percentile only from the dominant origin after threshold. Tradeoffs: storage + complexity.
Jen: Also add a note in rollout docs: normalizing routing tags can change observable aggregates even without latency regressions.
Alec: Action items: 1) Matt/Devon add a console badge for sample_count + top-origin (hotfix) — owner Matt. 2) Samira to prototype rollup-provenance retention strategy. 3) Jen to draft rollout note + SRE runbook update.
Matt: I'll open a PR with the badge change, will try to get it in today's patch window.
ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-20T22:15 UTC — console patch v0.9.3 promoted to staging.
Kara: Thanks. If anyone sees follow-up alerts we should mute noisy SLOs and annotate the incident as "aggregation provenance change".
Samira: One more gotcha — retries are tagged differently; merging will also change quantiles if retry samples are moved. We should include retry-tag in provenance UI.
Devon: Agreed. I'll add retry-tag to the badge scope.
Jen: I'll add Slack postmortem template note so oncall can triage attribution quickly next time.
Alec: Cool. Triage complete for now — we can track the rollup-provenance RFC in the eng-platform backlog. :thumbsup:
